pages.caption: Once upon a time, there was a magic monkey named Momo, who lived high up in a tall, tall tree.
One sunny morning, Momo found a sparkly golden banana. Ooooh! Magic!
Momo took one little bite, and whoosh! Momo could fly all around the jungle!
Momo flew home and shared the magic banana with all of Momo's friends. The end!
